signals.source_text: The COMPASS Lab of the Department of Aerospace Science and Technology - Politecnico di Milano at Politecnico di Milano is thrilled to have participated in the 2026 AAS/AIAA Astrodynamics Specialist Conference, held in Whistler, Canada. The conference brought together leading researchers from around the world in the field of #Astrodynamics , covering topics such as trajectory design and optimisation, spacecraft guidance, navigation and control, proximity operations, #SpaceDebris , and many others. The lab was represented by PhD students Alessandro Michelazzi , Eduardo Polli and Wiebke Retagne , who delivered oral presentations on the following topics: • “Adaptive GNSS-Based #RelativeNavigation for Close #FormationFlying Under Continuous Low-Thrust” - Alessandro Michelazzi , Gabriella Gaias , Camilla Colombo • “ #CollisionAvoidanceManoeuvre Design Under Operational Constraints Using Reaction Control Thrusters” - Eduardo Polli , Juan Luis Gonzalo Gómez , Camilla Colombo • “Generational Evolution of #ExplosionProbability : Investigating the Influence of #MitigationMeasures ” - Wiebke Retagne , Andrea Muciaccia , Camilla Colombo Pre-print versions of the papers are available through the conference website: https://lnkd.in/ejrccH5h Their work was supported by the #GREENSPECIES project, funded by the European Research Council (ERC) , and the Space It Up! project, funded by the Agenzia Spaziale Italiana and the Ministero dell'Università e della Ricerca .

signals.source_text: Ohio has the third-largest manufacturing workforce in the nation: nearly 690,000 Ohioans making the products the world depends on. That strength has been generations in the making. Two bicycle makers in Dayton taught the world to fly. Akron put the world on tires. Cleveland and the Mahoning Valley forged the steel that built America’s cities. And Marysville became home to the first Japanese automaker to build cars in the United States. Today, Ohio is putting that experience to work on what comes next. The same skilled workforce, deep supply chains and problem-solving culture now power the industries shaping the future: • Automotive and mobility • Healthcare and biotechnology • Aerospace and defense • Energy • Semiconductors and microelectronics • Food and agriculture …and much more. It’s why the largest capital investment, largest new-jobs project and largest aviation project in state history, from Intel , Anduril Industries and Joby Aviation , all chose Ohio. Here, you can dream it, build it, test it, and scale it. All October, we’re joining The Ohio Manufacturers'​ Association and manufacturers across the state to celebrate #ManufacturingMonth , honoring the people who built Ohio’s legacy and the innovators writing its next chapter. Ryan Augsburger , Karthik Avadhanula , JP Nauseef

signals.source_text: The EV didn't make NVH easier. It pushed the noise higher. Motor whine past 5 kHz. Gear mesh. Inverter harmonics. Road noise now the loudest source in the cabin. The Engineer's Guide to Modern NVH Simulation shows how to work the full range in MSC Nastran and Actran: heavy-fluid coupling, Virtual SEA, and ODYSSEE ROMs. Preview the first pages, then download the full guide below 👇
